definitions.explanation: A stringed instrument larger than a violin, played with a bow, with a deeper, mellower tone.

examples.japanese: ビオラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ビオラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}っている→習う：00479_narau⟧。
ビオラ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦バイオリン→バイオリン：00009_baiorin⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The viola is larger than the violin.

notes:
ビオラ is the Japanese name for the viola, a bowed string instrument slightly larger than a violin with a deeper, warmer tone.

STRING FAMILY (high to low):
- ⟦バイオリン→バイオリン：00009_baiorin⟧ (violin) — highest pitch
- ビオラ (viola)
- ⟦チェロ→チェロ：08115_chero⟧ (cello)
- ⟦コントラバス→コントラバス：08149_kontorabasu⟧ (double bass) — lowest pitch

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ビオラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧: to play the viola
- ビオラ⟦{奏者|そうしゃ}→奏者：06964_sousha⟧: viola player
- ビオラ⟦パート→パート：03106_paato⟧: viola section/part

USAGE:
The same word ビオラ also refers to violas and pansies (flowers). Context makes the meaning clear — the musical instrument is far more common in everyday usage.
